page_title: FRO 2-1 EMP | Frosinone v Empoli 06/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Stefano Turati is alert and denies him.
90+6' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
90+5' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
90+3' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle after Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
90+1' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

89' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom left corner, but great anticipation by Etrit Berisha allowed him to make a comfortable save.
88' Here comes a substitution. Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) is brought on as a substitute for Matias Soule.
88' The Empoli players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Gianluca Manganiello signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
88' The Empoli players joy may have been justified, because referee Gianluca Manganiello is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
87' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Francesco Caputo (Empoli) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

86' 2 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Nicolo Cambiaghi finds Francesco Caputo (Empoli), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Stefano Turati had no chance of stopping that. 2:1.
85' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 16:6.
83' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Reinier will be replaced by Marco Brescianini (Frosinone).
83' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) jumps into a tackle and Gianluca Manganiello signals a foul.
82' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
80' The substitution is prepared. Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Arijon Ibrahimovic.
80' Today's match ends for Marvin Cuni who will be replaced by Kaio Jorge (Frosinone).
77' Substitution. Simone Bastoni did his best and is replaced by Liberato Cacace (Empoli).
77' Aurelio Andreazzoli prepares a substitution. Alberto Grassi is replaced by Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli).
76' Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
74' 2 - 0 Goal! Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top left corner. He makes it 2:0.
72' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
71' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Etrit Berisha easily deals with the threat.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) for Matteo Cancellieri.
68' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
68' Matias Soule (Frosinone) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
66' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
62' Here is a change. Emmanuel Gyasi is going off and Aurelio Andreazzoli gives the last tactical orders to Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli).
62' Substitution. Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) replaces Razvan Marin.
62' Frosinone take a short corner kick.
61' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
60' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle. Alberto Grassi (Empoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.

58' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Arijon Ibrahimovic. The score is now 1:0.
58' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
57' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
54' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle after Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.

53' Reinier (Frosinone) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Etrit Berisha blocks the shot with his legs.
52' Matias Soule (Frosinone) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' Matias Soule (Frosinone) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
48' Matias Soule (Frosinone) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
48' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
47' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pol Lirola (Frosinone), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
46' The whistle blows and Gianluca Manganiello starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' What was Pol Lirola (Frosinone) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+1' Matias Soule (Frosinone) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
42' Reinier (Frosinone) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
41' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
41' Matias Soule (Frosinone) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
38' Frosinone quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
36' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
35' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
34' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
34' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
33' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and it's Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
32' Matias Soule (Frosinone) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
31' Matias Soule (Frosinone) takes the corner which is cleared.
30' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Frosinone.
28' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
25' The Empoli players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
24' A clever short pass gives Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
22' The goal by Frosinone won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
21' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Frosinone players aren’t happy.
20' Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Marvin Cuni (Frosinone), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
20' Matias Soule (Frosinone) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Arijon Ibrahimovic, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
19' Matias Soule (Frosinone) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
17' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
15' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) inside the box.
13' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
11' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
10' The ball is cleared after Reinier (Frosinone) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' Matteo Cancellieri swings in an inviting cross that finds Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli). He doesn't take advantage as his effort goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
7' Frosinone take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
7' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
6' Frosinone are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
3' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) takes a short corner kick.
3' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
2' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
